title: Talk:Sissirat
html:
Interesting strategy and different to me. I did him on normal at 11 or 12. I went first for Sissirat, then Rattletooth, then whiskers, and lastly the venomspitters. I dual wield and had yellow gear. At 16 I went back and began increasing the difficulties. By 18 I was farming him on insane. My skill bar was

L = empty

1 Unerving Shout

2 Soul Rend

3 Retribution

4 1H Swivel Arm Action

5 Poison Resistance

6 Gym Freak

7 Way of the Roo

8 Average BMI

R Holy Roller

I activate retribution, 1h swivel arm, poison resistance and charge in. I use the shout every so often. After the first few runs All the skills were levelled to their maximum levels and the gear slowly changed to Purples. Eventually I even got a mythic weapon. --Blue.octopus 17:51, 5 October 2007 (CEST)

I moved my strat from the main page to discussion. i figured it would be better not to clutter the main page. With the following setup Sissirat's Lair can be cleared in less than 3 minutes as a lvl 20 fighter.

L Butcher (Useless against Sissirat)

1 Righteous Stomp

2 1H Swivel Arm Action

3 Acidic Blight

4 Spontaneous Regeneration

5 Average BMI

6 Gym Freak

7 Way of the Roo

8 Poison Resistance

R Soul Rend

Start the fight by running into the middle of the room and hit Poison Resistance. While you're doing all this locate Rattle Toe and take him out first. Start with an Acidic Blight and then use Butcher as much as possible. Alternate that with Soul Rend until he's down. Next move to Sissirat. Use 1H Swivel Action at the start of the fight as well as Spontaneous Regeneration. As often as you can while fighting Sissirat use Righteous Stomp to avoid damage from poison from whiskers. Next move to the Poisonshooters using the Butcher + Soul Rend combo to keep them down. Finish off with the remaining whiskers and enjoy the goods!

--Cjudge
